label: Finding-39
title: release-time: Three of the cited sources state a schedule, not a release time
description: php.net's pre-announcement and the oss-security relay say 'It is scheduled for ... 14:00 UTC'; CERT-FR says the publisher 'annonce la disponibilit_ des correctifs ... pour le 21 octobre 2026 _ 16h00 heure de Paris (14h00 UTC)'; the Foundation says it 'moved the release ... to October 21st, 14:00 UTC'. None of these observes the release. The 'by' line should read 'scheduled for 14:00 UTC' with Daubois as the one after-the-event statement.
